comparison.objective: Draw one dose into an auto-disable syringe in one pull without push-back or overdraw.
comparison.physical_skill: Needle/vial handling and precise irreversible plunger force/displacement control.
comparison.success_condition: Correct dose drawn in a single pull, with no reverse stroke or overdraw; body lacks numeric dose tolerance.
comparison.reason: Both demand force regulation, but metered fluid aspiration through a plunger is not impact-induced notch fracture, insert protection, or fragment recovery.
